title: Engagement handoff: 30m playbook and facilitator prompts
content:
Purpose:
This is a compact, repeatable 30–35 minute facilitation playbook designed for a customer-facing renewal checkpoint or mid-quarter health sync where the goal is to (a) surface renewal signals, (b) align on concrete next steps, and (c) capture a 60-day activation mini-plan. Use when an exec-level QBR is not required or as a preflight to a larger review.

Who should run it:
- Primary facilitator: CSM (plays lead)
- Optional co-facilitator: Solutions Engineer or TAM for technical clarifications
- Attendees: Customer sponsor (product or Ops lead), 1–2 power users, CSM, SE/TAM, AM (if renewal window < 90 days)

Prep (CSM preflight checklist - to complete 24–48h before):
- Pull adoption metrics: DAU/MAU for product module X, key workflow completion rates, top 3 usage reports (link to dashboard).
- Bring revenue view: ARR at-risk, current committed ARR, renewal window date.
- Incident/Support snapshot: tickets opened in last 90 days, P1/P2 count, outstanding bugs.
- Bring product performance signals: latency trends, failed requests, embedding quality regressions (if any).
- Prepare a one-slide readout: top wins, top risks, proposed asks.
- Confirm attendees and calendar invite with 15m prep buffer for internal silent sync.
- Add links to artifacts in the invite: onboarding playbook, open roadmap items, pending quotes.

Meeting run-of-show (30–35 minutes):
1) 0:00–03:00 — Open + context (Facilitator)
  - Script: "Thanks for taking time. We’ll run a focused 30 minutes: quick health signals, a short technical check, and then align on decisions and next steps. Goal by the end: clear renewal posture and 60-day activation owner list."
  - Check-in: "Is there anything urgent to surface before we begin?" (If yes, call out and timebox)

2) 03:00–10:00 — Health snapshot (CSM)
  - One-slide with three bullets: adoption trend, business outcomes enabled, top blocker.
  - Script prompts: "Usage is up/down by X% — we think this ties to Y. What would you like to prioritize?"
  - Bring a 1–2 line customer-facing impact statement.

3) 10:00–18:00 — Technical alignment (SE/TAM)
  - Quick run of: integration health, latency/errors, open bugs, roadmap alignment.
  - Script prompt when presenting a risk: "This is the root cause we suspect. If we’re aligned, SE will scope an ETA for the fix and remediation steps."
  - If no technical issues: use the slot to demo a quick high-impact configuration that can improve value (ex: batching, caching change, or template prompt)

4) 18:00–26:00 — Renewal posture and options (CSM/AM)
  - Present a concise options matrix: Renew as-is; Renew with A; Pause/contract reduction; Early expansion (if over-indexed).
  - Script: "Based on signals, our recommendation is X. What are the constraints we should know about?"
  - Use a thermometer cue: Green = path clear, Yellow = conditional (action required), Red = at risk (escalate)

5) 26:00–32:00 — Decisions & 60-day activation plan (Facilitator)
  - Capture owners, ETA, and success measure for up to 3 discrete actions.
  - Script: "Who will own item A? Can we commit to XX date?"
  - Confirm follow-up: owner, due date, what success looks like.

6) 32:00–35:00 — Close & next steps (Facilitator)
  - Quick readout: restate decisions and owners.
  - Script: "I’ll send a 1–pager recap and schedule the next checkpoint. Anything else?"

Facilitation cue cards (quick lines to use live):
- When meeting goes off-rail: "This is valuable — can we park this in a follow-up thread and return to the agenda?"
- When stakeholders debate blame: "Let’s reframe: what outcome do we want and what three immediate actions move us closer?"
- If exec asks for more detail: "We can share a technical appendix after this call — I’ll loop the SE and send the artifact within 48 hours."
- When you need a commitment and get vague answers: "Can we convert that to a concrete owner and date?"

Renewal signals checklist (quick scoring):
- Usage: up > +10% (positive), flat (neutral), down > -10% (negative)
- Support volume: low (positive), medium (neutral), rising P1/P2 (negative)
- Business alignment: dedicated champion + roadmap tie (positive), passive users (negative)
- Financial signal: procurement engaged / budget confirmed (positive), no budget conversation (negative)
- Competitive movement: active RFP (negative)

Simple renewal tracker template (paste into CRM or Google Sheet):
Columns: Customer | Renewal window | Current ARR | Risk score (1–10) | Top blocker | Owner | Next milestone | Next milestone date | Notes/link artifacts
Example row: "Acme Corp | 2026-05-15 | $120k | 6 | Integration latency | Riley Torres | PoC config demo | 2026-03-25 | https://link/to/dashboard"

Decision capture shorthand (use in meeting):
- DECISION: Renew posture = [Green/Yellow/Red]; OWNER: [name]; ACTION: [one-line]; DUE: [YYYY-MM-DD]; SUCCESS: [metric or acceptance criteria]

Post-meeting follow-up template (send within 24h):
Subject: Recap + next steps — [Customer Name] 30m renewal checkpoint
Body: Short paragraphs: (1) Thank you. (2) Health snapshot: one sentence. (3) Decisions: bullet list (use Decision capture shorthand). (4) Next meeting: date if scheduled or suggested window. (5) Attach: one-slide readout + artifacts links.

Escalation play (when meeting lands at Red):
- Immediately flag AM and CSM manager.
- Book a 60–90m working session within 7 days with expanded stakeholders (product, procurement, engineering).
- Prepare a mitigation win-list: 3 items we can deliver in 14 days to reduce churn risk (technical patch, targeted enablement session, tailored ROI analysis).

Notes to facilitator (tips & gotchas):
- Keep slides to 3 facts max — folks will skim during a short call.
- Use the internal 15-minute silent sync before the customer call to calibrate ask lanes and who says what.
- If customer declines a follow-up, convert at least one item to a concrete owner and date to preserve momentum.
- Track verbal commitments in the CRM as tasks immediately post-call.

Lightweight appendix (copyable assets):
- One-slide summary template (title: Health | Risks | Recommendation) — include one chart and one quote from the customer.
- 15-minute silent sync agenda: 1) quick posture (2m), 2) who says what (8m), 3) escalation plan (3m), 4) confirm slides (2m).
- Suggested Slack message to internal team pre-call: "Heads up: 30m renewal checkpoint with [Customer] at [time]. Focus: adoption & renewal posture. Bring metrics: usage trend + top open bug. Silent sync 15 min before."

Why this format:
We see many renewal conversations derail because the meeting is either too long, unfocused, or lacks a concrete owner for the next step. This compact playbook forces a quick alignment loop, captures decisions in a standard shorthand, and creates an auditable trail that feeds our CRM and renewal forecast.

Open questions / TODOs (for improvement):
- Add a simple NPS-like micro-question to ask at the end (1–2 questions) and capture responses centrally.
- Experiment with a 20m version for smaller accounts.
- Create a quick scoring widget in the CS dashboard to push the renewal signals automatically.

End of document.
